title: FlashScript: Compiling Recurring Agent Workflows into Reusable Neuro-Symbolic Programs
title_zh: FlashScript：将重复的智能体工作流编译为可复用的神经符号程序

paragraphs.en: Many agent tasks recur with new data or small changes, yet agents regenerate their reasoning and actions on each run, producing different results. Distilling a prior run into a skill helps the agent avoid earlier mistakes, but it still re-runs the full process each time, so runs can vary and incur that cost. We compile a successful agent run into a reusable neuro-symbolic program (NSP) with a set of guidelines we call FlashScript . Actions and data transformations become code, instance-specific values become parameters, and decisions that need model judgment become LLM calls. We identify three layers where these calls belong and three techniques that replace most of them with code. The compilation does not remove nondeterminism; it localizes it, so the deterministic program and its neural calls can be reviewed and tested separately. Across 120 WorkBench analytics tasks with Claude Haiku 4.5, the NSPs were correct and made identical tool calls on every run, using about 70 times fewer input tokens and a third of the runtime of a skill-guided agent whose runs were inconsistent. In a composite version of the tasks, the skill-guided agent’s accuracy fell to 23%, and its output inconsistency increased, while the NSPs remained correct and identical across all runs. The NSPs successfully generalized to all 108 unseen instances of the same templates. Our findings suggest that NSPs from agent trajectories can be considered cumulative software assets for end-users to test, maintain, and reuse in their recurring workflows.

paragraphs.en: AI agents are increasingly performing recurring tasks on behalf of end users. For example, an analyst asks an agent to update a weekly report using data from several sources without writing the code to retrieve, combine, and format it. By translating natural-language requests into tool actions, agents advance the long-standing vision of end-user software engineering: letting people automate their own specialized needs [ 1 ] . Yet these agentic workflows do not behave like conventional software. An agent reconstructs the procedure on every run, so repeated executions of the same request can diverge in path and outcome [ 2 , 3 ] . A successful execution holds valuable procedural knowledge: which tools to use, what went wrong, and which decisions produced a desirable result [ 4 , 5 ] . Currently, this knowledge is buried within the session: a user may inspect, correct, and approve a run, but that effort never carries over to future executions. Users must therefore keep inspecting an already reviewed procedure.
paragraphs.zh: AI 智能体正越来越多地代表最终用户执行重复性任务。 例如，分析师可以让智能体利用来自多个数据源的数据更新周报，而无需自己编写用于检索、合并和格式化数据的代码。 通过将自然语言请求转化为工具操作，智能体推动了最终用户软件工程这一长期愿景的实现：让人们能够自动化自己的专门需求 [ 1 ] 。 然而，这些智能体化的工作流并不像传统软件那样运行。 智能体在每次运行时都会重新构建执行过程，因此同一请求的重复执行可能在路径和结果上出现分歧 [ 2 , 3 ] 。 一次成功的执行蕴含着宝贵的过程性知识：该使用哪些工具、哪里出了问题，以及哪些决策产生了理想的结果 [ 4 , 5 ] 。 目前，这些知识被埋没在会话之中：用户可以检查、纠正并批准一次运行，但这些努力无法延续到未来的执行中。 因此，用户不得不反复检查一个本已经审阅过的过程。

paragraphs.en: Prior work has attempted to preserve successful agent behavior in several forms. Experience-based memory and workflow methods extract demonstrations, guidelines, or natural-language routines from past trajectories and retrieve them to guide later executions [ 4 , 6 , 5 ] . These methods help agents reuse experience, but the model must still interpret that guidance and decide how to execute it, so runs still vary. At the other extreme, programming-by-demonstration and robotic process automation record and replay concrete action sequences [ 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 ] ; they preserve execution more directly but generalize poorly when the inputs or environment change. More recent methods compile agent traces into reusable artifacts: procedural skills in SKILL-DISCO, programmatic skills via neuro-symbolic learning, and mostly deterministic workflows in TraceCompiler [ 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 ] . These show the promise of trajectory compilation but leave open where the model’s judgment must remain, and they do not address inconsistency. What is missing is a consistent yet generalizable process that a user can rerun on each recurrence of their workflow.
paragraphs.zh: 先前的工作已尝试以多种形式保留成功的智能体行为。 基于经验的记忆与工作流方法从过去的轨迹中提取示范、指南或自然语言例程，并在后续执行中检索它们以提供指导 [ 4 , 6 , 5 ] 。 这些方法帮助智能体复用经验，但模型仍须解读这些指导并决定如何执行，因此各次运行之间仍存在差异。 在另一个极端，示范编程与机器人流程自动化会记录并回放具体的动作序列 [ 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 ] ；它们更直接地保留了执行过程，但在输入或环境发生变化时泛化能力较差。 更近期的方法将智能体轨迹编译为可复用的产物：SKILL-DISCO 中的程序性技能、通过神经符号学习得到的程序化技能，以及 TraceCompiler 中以确定性为主的工作流 [ 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 ] 。 这些工作展示了轨迹编译的前景，但未能回答模型判断必须在何处保留的问题，也没有解决不一致性。 所缺失的，是一个既一致又可泛化的过程，使用户能够在工作流每次重现时重新运行它。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we explore how a recurring agent task can be preserved as a reusable NSP (Fig. 1 -bottom), with guidelines we call FlashScript. A completed run is a natural starting point because users often reach it through several turns of feedback and manual fixes with an agent. Our method builds on that interaction to create an NSP. The compilation turns actions into code, instance-specific values into parameters, and represents each decision that requires model judgment as a typed call llm<T> , which returns a value of declared type T T , at a fixed point in the code. We identify three layers where these calls belong, the input, computation, and output layers, and three techniques that replace most of them with code: caching observed values behind a guard, codifying judgments as rules, and clubbing independent questions into a call. An NSP would consistently follow the same steps, invoking the model only when needed to answer scoped questions.
paragraphs.zh: 本文探讨如何将一个反复出现的智能体任务保存为可复用的 NSP（图 1 -底部），并提出了我们称之为 FlashScript 的指导准则。 一次已完成的运行是自然的起点，因为用户通常是通过与智能体的多轮反馈和手动修正才达到这一步的。 我们的方法正是在这种交互的基础上构建 NSP。 该编译过程将动作转化为代码，将特定实例的值转化为参数，并把每个需要模型判断的决策表示为类型化的调用 llm<T>，它在代码中的固定位置返回声明类型 T T 的值。 我们确定了这些调用所属的三个层次，即输入层、计算层和输出层，并提出了三种用代码替代其中大部分调用的技术：通过守卫缓存观测值、将判断固化为规则，以及把相互独立的问题合并为一次调用。 NSP 会始终如一地执行相同的步骤，只在需要回答限定范围的问题时才调用模型。

They do not eliminate nondeterminism, but they localize it. Each neural call has an explicit input format, output type, and defined use in the NSP. This structure facilitates the separate testing and maintenance of the deterministic code and neural components.

paragraphs.en: Imagine an analyst who maintains a workbook of available rental listings for his clients each week. Prices may change, some listings may be rented, and new rentals may become available. Scam listings are also a big concern in large cities; therefore, he wants to help his clients avoid them. So every Monday morning, he asks an agent to “ update LA rentals and flag scams ” (Fig. 1 -top). The workbook has a separate sheet for each city. The agent first infers that “LA” in the query refers to Los Angeles and selects the corresponding sheet. It updates the workbook by fetching and merging new listings, then flags listings that request a money transfer before the first visit as potential scams. Finally, it summarizes the changes.

paragraphs.en: FlashScript is our authoring guidance for writing these NSPs from prior agent runs. Programs that combine code and invocations to learned models have a long history [ 18 ] , and LLMs have made them more common. Models can serve as semantic predicates in synthesized programs [ 19 ] , as functions in generated programs [ 20 , 21 , 22 ] , and as operators in data pipelines [ 23 ] . We derive such an NSP from a given user’s session with an AI agent. We turn a completed agent trajectory into a script with an additional operation, llm<T> , which sends a prompt to a model and returns a value of a declared type, such as a string, Boolean, or option. The run’s actions become code, while its reasoning becomes model calls to be made when a future run requires judgment.
paragraphs.zh: FlashScript 是我们用于从先前的智能体运行中编写这些 NSP 的创作指南。 将代码与对学习模型的调用相结合的程序有着悠久的历史 [ 18 ] ，而 LLM 使它们变得更加常见。 模型可以在合成程序中充当语义谓词 [ 19 ] ，在生成的程序中充当函数 [ 20 , 21 , 22 ] ，以及在数据管道中充当运算符 [ 23 ] 。 我们从给定用户与 AI 智能体的会话中推导出这样的 NSP。 我们将一个已完成的智能体轨迹转换为一个脚本，并附加一个操作 llm<T> ，该操作向模型发送提示并返回一个已声明类型的值，例如字符串、布尔值或选项。 运行中的动作变成代码，而其推理则变成在未来的运行需要判断时所要进行的模型调用。

paragraphs.en: Fixing the Actions (C1). Each of the neural calls in NSPs is bounded. The NSP selects its inputs, checks that the response has the expected type [ 24 , 25 , 26 ] , and makes the call at a fixed point in the code. The NSP’s control flow determines when the model is queried, for what, and how its response is used. As a result, variation across runs is confined to those calls.
paragraphs.zh: 修复动作（C1）。 神经程序综合（NSP）中的每次神经调用都是有界的。 NSP 选择其输入，检查响应是否具有预期的类型 [24, 25, 26]，并在代码中的固定位置发起调用。 NSP 的控制流决定了何时查询模型、查询什么内容，以及如何使用其响应。 因此，多次运行之间的变化仅限于这些调用。

sents.en: Fixing the Actions (C1).
sents.zh: 修复动作（C1）。

sents.en: Each of the neural calls in NSPs is bounded.
sents.zh: 神经程序综合（NSP）中的每次神经调用都是有界的。

sents.en: The NSP selects its inputs, checks that the response has the expected type [ 24 , 25 , 26 ] , and makes the call at a fixed point in the code.
sents.zh: NSP 选择其输入，检查响应是否具有预期的类型 [24, 25, 26]，并在代码中的固定位置发起调用。

paragraphs.en: Locating the Neural Part (C2). The calls fall into three layers, based on how information moves through the workflow. Input layer calls turn unstructured text into typed values, such as identifying which sheet “L.A.” refers to. Computation layer calls make semantic decisions that are difficult to express as rules, such as whether a listing is a scam. Output layer calls render computed results in natural language for the task owner.
paragraphs.zh: 定位神经部分（C2）。 这些调用按信息在工作流中的流动方式分为三层。 输入层调用将非结构化文本转换为有类型的值，例如识别“L.A.”指的是哪个工作表。 计算层调用做出难以用规则表达的语义判断，例如判断某条房源信息是否为骗局。 输出层调用以自然语言向任务负责人呈现计算结果。

paragraphs.en: A program with no model calls is a fixed script: it is consistent, but limited only to the inputs it was generated from. And a program that relies solely on model calls is equivalent to the reason-action agent loop. NSPs sit between these two ends. They keep actions as code and use the model calls only where expected. Their generality depends on how many decisions they leave to model calls: delegating more handles more variation but reduces consistency and efficiency.
paragraphs.zh: 不调用模型的程序是一段固定脚本：它具有一致性，但只能局限于生成它时所依据的输入。 而仅依赖模型调用的程序等价于“推理-行动”智能体循环。 NSP 则处于这两个极端之间。 它们将动作保留为代码，只在预期之处使用模型调用。 它们的通用性取决于将多少决策留给模型调用：委派得越多，能应对的变化越多，但一致性和效率会降低。

sents.zh: 不调用模型的程序是一段固定脚本：它具有一致性，但只能局限于生成它时所依据的输入。

sents.zh: 它们的通用性取决于将多少决策留给模型调用：委派得越多，能应对的变化越多，但一致性和效率会降低。

paragraphs.en: Efficient Decision Making (C3). Unlike an agent that makes an LLM call at every step, each reading the growing history, an NSP pays only for its limited expected number of model calls. Its expected cost depends on how often each call is made and how large it is. We propose three techniques that can make calls less frequent or smaller, further reducing costs. Caching keeps a value observed in the run and checks a condition before reusing it in a future run. The model is called only if that condition fails. For example, the sheet lookup in Fig. 1 checks the SHEETS dictionary and falls back to an LLM call choosing from existing sheets. Codifying replaces a repeatable judgment with a heuristic rule. Writing the rule once costs less than asking the model every run and gives the same answer each time. Unlike program-aided reasoning [ 27 , 28 ] , the model does not make the decision by executing generated code. In Fig. 1 , a regex such as (send|pay).*(Venmo|Zelle).*before.* could flag the requests for suspicious payment before a visit, indicating potential scams. Clubbing puts independent questions in one call or runs them in parallel [ 29 , 30 ] . These typed questions can also go to smaller classification models [ 31 , 32 ] , since the generative capacity of an LLM is not required.
paragraphs.zh: 高效决策（C3）。 与在每个步骤都进行一次 LLM 调用并读取不断增长的历史记录的智能体不同，NSP 只需为其有限次数的预期模型调用付费。 其预期成本取决于每次调用的频率以及调用的规模大小。 我们提出三种技术，可以降低调用频率或减小调用规模，从而进一步降低成本。 缓存会保存在运行中观察到的值，并在未来的运行中复用它之前检查一个条件。 只有当该条件不成立时才调用模型。 例如，图 1 中的表格查找会检查 SHEETS 字典，若未命中则回退到一次 LLM 调用，从现有表格中进行选择。 规则固化是用启发式规则替代可重复的判断。 一次性编写规则的成本低于每次运行都询问模型，并且每次都能给出相同的答案。 与程序辅助推理 [ 27 , 28 ] 不同，模型并不通过执行生成的代码来做决策。 在图 1 中，诸如 (send|pay).*(Venmo|Zelle).*before.* 这样的正则表达式可以标记出访问前涉及可疑支付的请求，表明可能存在诈骗。 合并调用将相互独立的问题放入一次调用中，或并行运行它们 [ 29 , 30 ] 。 这些类型化的问题也可以交给更小的分类模型处理 [ 31 , 32 ] ，因为它们不需要 LLM 的生成能力。

sents.en: We compared the NSPs with a vanilla agent and a skill-guided agent on the WorkBench benchmark [ 16 ] and evaluate whether they meet consistency (C1), generalization (C2), and cost-effectiveness (C3) criteria.

paragraphs.en: Setup. WorkBench’s 690 tasks came from 69 request templates with ten instances each. We took its 12 Analytics templates (120 tasks), in which the agent must read data, compute a value, compare it to a threshold, and decide whether and what to plot. For example, the template “ If { metric } is more than { threshold } { higher or lower } than { date } , make a line plot of it since then ” has the instance “ If engaged users is more than 10% lower than November 24, make a line plot of it since then .” Other task categories are mostly single-record edits, leaving little room for runs to differ. We first run the vanilla agent three times on every task. Then for each template, WorkBench’s grader selected the best run and a coding agent (Claude Code Opus 5.5) wrote the skill from that run. The coding agent also wrote each NSP from FlashScript instructions (Section III ) that provide the prompt template, the tool descriptions, and the same agent trajectory used to write the skill (the R + T condition in Table II ). We ran the skill-guided agent and the NSP three times on every task. All runs used Claude Haiku 4.5, chosen for its favorable performance–cost trade-off, at temperature 1, a common setting that reflects typical LLM generation behavior.

paragraphs.en: To examine how performance changes with task size, we combined requests from different templates into single prompts (“ Please do all of the following: 1. … 2. … ”), using only instances not used to create the skill or NSP. paragraphs.en: Consistency (C1). The vanilla agent’s runs were inconsistent: only 82% of its repeated runs ended in the same state as the first run (Table I ). The skill reduced most of this inconsistency but did not remove it completely (99%). The NSP made the same tool calls in every run, and across runs only the wording of its reply varies. On composite tasks, agents become less consistent (Fig. 2 b-f): with ten subtasks, the skilled agent reproduces the outcome of its first run in only 10% of cases while working on the exact same task, receiving every subtask’s skill and appearing to mix them up, adding plots no subtask requested and omitting some that were. The NSP, by contrast, produces the exact same result in every run.
paragraphs.zh: 一致性（C1）。 原始智能体的多次运行结果不一致：其重复运行中只有 82% 与第一次运行结束在相同状态（表 I）。 技能减少了大部分这种不一致，但并未完全消除（99%）。 NSP 在每次运行中调用相同的工具，且各次运行之间只有其回复的措辞不同。 在复合任务上，智能体的一致性下降（图 2 b-f）：当包含十个子任务时，即使处理的任务完全相同，技能型智能体也只有 10% 的情况能复现其第一次运行的结果，它似乎将各子任务的技能混在一起，添加了没有子任务要求的图表，同时遗漏了某些被要求的图表。 相比之下，NSP 在每次运行中都能产生完全相同的结果。

paragraphs.en: Generalizability (C2). On repeated tasks, the vanilla agent was often correct (accuracy 0.89), and the skill reached 0.97. They were correct in all three runs on 79% and 96% of tasks, respectively (Table I ). Meanwhile, the NSP was correct on every single run (accuracy 1.0). Among the tasks, eight templates needed a decision about the data, such as whether a metric crossed a threshold or which date in the data “Saturday” refers to. These templates account for 34 of the vanilla agent’s 39 errors and all 11 of the skilled agent’s. The skilled agent fails in two ways. When the skill was correct, the agent still made mistakes, for example by wrongly summing daily values in its reasoning ( 2 + 3 + 6 + 3 + 8 + 5 + ⋯ = 148 2+3+6+3+8+5+\dots=148 visits). In other cases, the skill inherits a heuristic that was not generalizable beyond the reference run. One template asks to compare a metric’s percent growth, but the reference run compared their sums instead; both agreed there, so the grader accepted it, and the skill kept the shortcut, dropping accuracy to 0.67 against 0.87 for the vanilla agent on that task.

paragraphs.en: Cost (C3). The NSP used about 70 times fewer input tokens and about a third of the runtime of either agent (Table I ). Across all NSPs there are 69 neural calls, 49 guarded input calls and 20 reply calls, averaging 1.5 per run. On composite tasks its runtime grows from 1.4 to 6.0 seconds, against about 26 to 30 for the agents. All three reduction techniques from Section III helped: caching served 37 of the 49 guarded input calls from a stored value instead of the model, codifying turned every computation-layer decision into a rule, and clubbing combined independent questions into one call, cutting a ten-subtask task from 5.8 model questions to 2.0.

paragraphs.en: We also studied how an NSP’s quality depends on the generation instructions and on the trajectory. Our first instructions asked the agent only to write an NSP from a template or a trajectory; those NSPs achieved 0.96 and 0.88 accuracy, respectively, but failed on reworded requests and edge cases. Accuracy reached 1.00 once we asked the agent to plan first, encode decisions as rules, and place calls according to their layer (available in supplementary materials 1 1 1 https://figshare.com/s/c812d719d2d43bae034c ). With these instructions, we wrote NSPs from three inputs: the template only (T), the run alone (R), and the template with the skill’s reference run (R+T) (Table II ). Only using the run makes the NSP too specific. It is correct on the instance it is generated from, but fails on unseen instances. Using the template alone already yields good generalization. It identifies the variables and plans for the variants. Adding the run to the template strengthens the NSP’s caches by setting more inclusive guards, reducing the number of calls from 1.8 to 1.5. The run also exposes the agent’s decisions to review. For example, the plan caught the reference run’s shortcut for summing and corrected it. In short, correctness comes from the template and the planning instructions, while the run contributes efficiency through tighter caches and auditability by exposing the reference run’s decisions for review.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还研究了 NSP 的质量如何取决于生成指令和轨迹。 我们最初的一版指令只要求智能体从模板或轨迹生成 NSP；这类 NSP 分别达到了 0.96 和 0.88 的准确率，但在改写过的请求和边界情形上会失败。 当我们要求智能体先做规划、将决策编码为规则，并根据层次安排调用后，准确率达到了 1.00（见补充材料 1 1 1 https://figshare.com/s/c812d719d2d43bae034c ）。 采用这些指令，我们从三种输入生成 NSP：仅模板（T）、仅运行记录（R）、以及模板加该技能的参考运行记录（R+T）（表 II ）。 只使用运行记录会使 NSP 过于特化。 它在其生成所依据的实例上是正确的，但在未见过的实例上会失败。 仅使用模板就已经能带来良好的泛化能力。 它能识别变量并为各种变体做好规划。 在模板基础上加入运行记录，通过设置更宽松的守卫条件增强了 NSP 的缓存，将调用次数从 1.8 降至 1.5。 运行记录还使智能体的决策可供审查。 例如，规划过程发现了参考运行记录中求和时的捷径并加以纠正。 简言之，正确性来自模板和规划指令，而运行记录通过更紧凑的缓存贡献了效率，并通过暴露参考运行记录的决策供审查而提供了可审计性。

sents.zh: 当我们要求智能体先做规划、将决策编码为规则，并根据层次安排调用后，准确率达到了 1.00（见补充材料 1 1 1 https://figshare.com/s/c812d719d2d43bae034c ）。

sents.en: With these instructions, we wrote NSPs from three inputs: the template only (T), the run alone (R), and the template with the skill’s reference run (R+T) (Table II ).
sents.zh: 采用这些指令，我们从三种输入生成 NSP：仅模板（T）、仅运行记录（R）、以及模板加该技能的参考运行记录（R+T）（表 II ）。

sents.en: Only using the run makes the NSP too specific.
sents.zh: 只使用运行记录会使 NSP 过于特化。

sents.en: It is correct on the instance it is generated from, but fails on unseen instances.
sents.zh: 它在其生成所依据的实例上是正确的，但在未见过的实例上会失败。

sents.en: Using the template alone already yields good generalization.
sents.zh: 仅使用模板就已经能带来良好的泛化能力。

sents.en: It identifies the variables and plans for the variants.
sents.zh: 它能识别变量并为各种变体做好规划。

sents.en: Adding the run to the template strengthens the NSP’s caches by setting more inclusive guards, reducing the number of calls from 1.8 to 1.5.
sents.zh: 在模板基础上加入运行记录，通过设置更宽松的守卫条件增强了 NSP 的缓存，将调用次数从 1.8 降至 1.5。

sents.en: The run also exposes the agent’s decisions to review.
sents.zh: 运行记录还使智能体的决策可供审查。

sents.en: For example, the plan caught the reference run’s shortcut for summing and corrected it.
sents.zh: 例如，规划过程发现了参考运行记录中求和时的捷径并加以纠正。

sents.en: In short, correctness comes from the template and the planning instructions, while the run contributes efficiency through tighter caches and auditability by exposing the reference run’s decisions for review.
sents.zh: 简言之，正确性来自模板和规划指令，而运行记录通过更紧凑的缓存贡献了效率，并通过暴露参考运行记录的决策供审查而提供了可审计性。

paragraphs.en: NSPs also changes what users retain after a successful run: reusable software that can be parameterized, combined with other NSPs, and maintained over time.
paragraphs.zh: NSP 还改变了用户在成功运行后所保留的内容：可参数化、可与其他 NSP 组合并可长期维护的可复用软件。

paragraphs.en: User Interaction with NSPs. Instead of having an agent solve the same task from scratch each time, the user keeps an NSP they reuse. An NSP can expose user-facing parameters for the task. For a scam check, the user could choose a heuristic from a menu or describe what they consider a scam as a text input. The NSP includes that preference in its LLM scam-check call, grounding the model’s judgment in the user’s criteria. The user can change the preference and see its effect on the output within seconds.
paragraphs.zh: 用户与NSP的交互。 与其每次让智能体从零开始解决相同任务，用户可以保留一个NSP并重复使用它。 NSP可以针对该任务暴露面向用户的参数。 对于诈骗检查，用户可以从菜单中选择一种启发式方法，或者以文本输入的方式描述他们认为什么是诈骗。 NSP会将该偏好包含在其LLM诈骗检查调用中，使模型的判断基于用户的标准。 用户可以更改该偏好，并在几秒钟内看到其对输出的影响。

paragraphs.en: Software Lifecycle and Testing. Because the compiled control flow is fixed and separates deterministic code from model calls, making LLM-based systems easier to analyze and validate [ 33 ] , NSPs can follow the same lifecycle as other software. Developers can inspect the control flow before deployment, see which steps run and where the model is called, and remove the “black-box” risk of an agent. Testing then splits by component: the symbolic shell takes the usual unit, integration, and regression tests; the neural calls, whose outputs vary across runs and models, need contract, repeated-sampling, and metamorphic tests; and the seam must check the shell handles any value of a call’s return type T T . As a workflow settles, refactoring, such as rule codification, replaces neural calls with deterministic code.
paragraphs.zh: 软件生命周期与测试。 由于编译后的控制流是固定的，并将确定性代码与模型调用分离开来，使得基于大语言模型的系统更易于分析和验证 [ 33 ]，神经符号程序（NSP）可以遵循与其他软件相同的生命周期。 开发人员可以在部署前检查控制流，查看哪些步骤会运行以及在哪里调用模型，从而消除智能体的“黑盒”风险。 测试随后按组件划分：符号外壳接受常规的单元测试、集成测试和回归测试；神经调用（其输出在不同运行和不同模型之间会有差异）需要契约测试、重复采样测试和蜕变测试；而接合处必须检查外壳能否处理调用的返回类型 T T 的任意值。 随着工作流逐渐稳定，诸如规则编码化之类的重构会用确定性代码替换神经调用。

paragraphs.en: Benchmarking Nuanced Decisions. Agent benchmarks favor tasks with clear, verifiable outcomes, so they rarely capture the nuanced decisions involved in recurring work. Real tasks may require models to infer constraints, interpret vague terms such as “suspicious,” weigh personal preferences, or frame open-ended problems [ 34 , 35 , 36 , 37 , 38 , 39 , 40 , 41 , 42 ] . A dataset of such workflows would clarify the boundary of when an NSP neural calls.
paragraphs.zh: 对细微决策进行基准测试。 智能体基准测试倾向于具有清晰、可验证结果的任务，因此它们很少能捕捉到重复性工作中涉及的细微决策。 真实任务可能要求模型推断约束条件、解释诸如“可疑”这类模糊的措辞、权衡个人偏好，或对开放式问题进行框定 [ 34 , 35 , 36 , 37 , 38 , 39 , 40 , 41 , 42 ] 。 这样一个工作流数据集将有助于厘清智能体何时调用 NSP 神经的边界。

paragraphs.en: We will build a benchmark of recurring workflows that test the nuanced decisions an agent must make before acting. Most benchmarks focus on whether the agent uses the right tools, even if it misunderstood the task. Our benchmark will test whether it can infer unstated constraints, define vague terms such as “suspicious” [ 42 ] , weigh personal preferences, and decide what to investigate when there is no clear path or success measure. Each workflow will include successive instances, with real users’ judgments as ground truth. We will test how well caches and guards handle changing data, and measure each model call’s accuracy and consistency in a NSP separately from task execution.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将构建一个由重复性工作流组成的基准测试，用以检验智能体在行动之前必须做出的各种细微决策。 大多数基准测试关注的是智能体是否使用了正确的工具，即使它误解了任务。 我们的基准测试将检验它能否推断未明说的约束条件、定义诸如“可疑”这类模糊术语 [ 42 ] 、权衡个人偏好，并在没有明确路径或成功衡量标准时决定该调查什么。 每个工作流将包含连续的多个实例，并以真实用户的判断作为基准真值。 我们将测试缓存和防护机制处理变化数据的能力，并在 NSP 中单独衡量每次模型调用的准确性与一致性，而与任务执行分开。

paragraphs.en: Additionally, we will study interfaces that let end-user developers inspect and customize NSPs without reading code. Users could set text or menu parameters, edit steps or model guidance, and see the effect on outputs instantly. Further user studies will explore which parameters to expose, how users want to set them for an NSP, and what they expect NSPs to generalize across recurring runs.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，我们将研究让最终用户开发者无需阅读代码即可检查和定制 NSP 的界面。 用户可以设置文本或菜单参数，编辑步骤或模型引导，并即时看到对输出的影响。 进一步的用户研究将探索应该公开哪些参数、用户希望如何为 NSP 设置这些参数，以及他们期望 NSP 在重复运行中如何进行泛化。

paragraphs.en: Finally, we will make NSP coverage visible for the user. For each new request, model calls will identify its requirements and check which ones the NSP can handle. Covered requirements will run as code, and a fallback agentic step will handle the rest and can update the NSP. Over time, the NSP can cover more scenarios and data structures, so more of each request can run as reviewed code.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，我们将让用户能够看到 NSP 的覆盖情况。 对于每个新请求，模型调用会识别其需求，并检查哪些需求是 NSP 可以处理的。 已覆盖的需求将以代码形式运行，而一个回退的智能体步骤会处理其余部分，并可以更新 NSP。 随着时间推移，NSP 可以覆盖更多场景和数据结构，因此每个请求中可以有更多部分以经过审查的代码形式运行。
